question_text: A 3670-g (8 lb 1 oz) male newborn is delivered to a 26-year-old primigravid woman. She received adequate prenatal care and labor was uncomplicated. She has chronic hepatitis B infection and gastroesophageal reflux disease. Her only medication is ranitidine. She admits to smoking cannabis and one half-pack of cigarettes daily. She drinks two beers on the weekend. The mother is apprehensive about taking care of her baby and requests for some information regarding breastfeeding. Which of the following is a contraindication to breastfeeding?
